steps.text: To make the pheasant, preheat the oven to 180C/160C Fan/Gas 4.

steps.text: Wrap each pheasant breast in 4 slices of pancetta.

steps.text: Heat the butter in a heavy-based, ovenproof frying pan, then fry the breasts over a medium heat for 2–3 minutes. Turn them over and fry for a further 2 minutes, then transfer the pan to the oven and cook the breasts for 4–5 minutes, or until cooked through. Check the internal temperature with a meat thermometer inserted into the thickest part of one of the breasts – it should be 63C. Keep the breasts warm.

Keep the sauce warm.

recipeInstructions: To make the pheasant, preheat the oven to 180C/160C Fan/Gas 4.
Wrap each pheasant breast in 4 slices of pancetta.

Heat the butter in a heavy-based, ovenproof frying pan, then fry the breasts over a medium heat for 2–3 minutes. Turn them over and fry for a further 2 minutes, then transfer the pan to the oven and cook the breasts for 4–5 minutes, or until cooked through. Check the internal temperature with a meat thermometer inserted into the thickest part of one of the breasts – it should be 63C. Keep the breasts warm.

To make the sauce, melt the butter in a saucepan, add the shallots and fry gently until soft. Add the mushrooms and fry for 2–3 minutes. Pour in the whisky, stock and cream. Bring to the boil, then immediately turn the heat down to a simmer and cook for a couple of minutes until bubbling and thickened. Add the chopped parsley, then season with salt and pepper. Keep the sauce warm.

To make the rostï, mix the celeriac, parsnip and apple together in a large bowl. Wrap the celeriac mixture in a clean tea towel and wring out the excess moisture. Put the mixture back in the bowl, add the flour and enough of the egg to bind the mixture together. Season with salt and pepper.
Heat the butter and oil in a large frying pan. Divide the mixture into four and, using your hands, shape into four flattish patties about the size of your palm.
Fry the patties for 4–5 minutes over a medium heat, then flip them over and cook for another 3–4 minutes.

To serve, slice the pheasant breasts on the diagonal into 1.5cm/¾in thick slices (or leave whole if desired). Serve each breast on a warmed plate on top of a rösti, with the sauce spooned around. Garnish with the parsley sprigs.
